summary: Wires the debug adapter of a csolution target so that Load & Debug works, and verifies it on the target with a breakpoint and the serial console.
triggers: a new target has no debugger yet
cmsis_action says a CMSIS task is not offered
stop_conditions: If the internal flash has no algorithm in the cbuild-run file, programming cannot work whatever the adapter is. Report that first.
Ask the user which probe is on the board or on the desk.
With several probes connected, the probe is chosen by the setting `cmsis-csolution.probe-id`, not in the csolution. Ask the user to set it.
When the files did not change: ask the user to open **Manage Solution Settings** in the CMSIS view and to confirm the debugger there, or to check that `cmsis-csolution.autoDebugLaunch` is on.
A launch configuration whose `cmsis` node says `"updateConfiguration": "manual"` is never rewritten; leave it alone and tell the user.
Ask the user to connect the board.

extracted.title: Debugger adapter names for the csolution debugger node
extracted.body: CMSIS-DAP@pyOCD, ST-Link@pyOCD, ULINKplus@pyOCD, MCU-Link@pyOCD, Nu-Link@pyOCD, KitProg3@pyOCD, PICkit@pyOCD, RPiDebugProbe@pyOCD, J-Link Server, Arm-FVP (use proc-fvp-debug-setup). Use a name exactly as `csolution list debuggers` prints it.

extracted.title: Debugger node in a csolution target set
extracted.body:
target-types:
    - type: <target-type>
      board: <vendor>::<board>
      device: <device>
      target-set:
        - set:
          images:
            - project-context: <project>.Debug
          debugger:
            name: <adapter name>

extracted.title: updateConfiguration auto versus manual in launch.json
extracted.body: A launch configuration whose `cmsis` node says `"updateConfiguration": "manual"` is never rewritten; leave it alone and tell the user.

extracted.title: Load runs the firmware before the debugger attaches
extracted.body: In `load_and_debug` the pre-launch `CMSIS Load` task programs and starts the image; the session then restarts it and halts at `main`. A complete run's output can already be in the serial buffer at the first stop. Do not count that run twice.

extracted.title: A silent UART
extracted.body: Halt, and read the UART's status, control and baud-rate registers with `read_peripheral_register`. A status register at its reset value means the peripheral is alive and its configuration is wrong; all zeros, or the same value in every register, means its clock was never enabled.
